in_arabic.name: Dakhil
in_arabic.long_meaning: Dakhil هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'dakha' meaning 'to enter'. In Islamic tradition, Dakhil is the name of an Angel who invites believers to enter Paradise. It also represents the entrance to knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual growth.
